conventions.convention: Scalars are complex; the simple labels are 1, ψ and σ. Their fusion rules include ψ⊗ψ=1, ψ⊗σ=σ⊗ψ=σ and σ⊗σ=1⊕ψ. No braiding or physical realization is included in the abstract data.

The associator goes from (a⊗b)⊗c to a⊗(b⊗c); its first channel index is the left intermediate label and its second is the right intermediate label. The σσσ block uses the order (1,ψ) and the positive Hadamard matrix divided by √2. The exceptional scalar coefficients F(ψσψ;σ) and F(σψσ;ψ) are −1.

Each simple label is self-dual. Evaluation and coevaluation have coefficient 1 for 1 and ψ, and 2^(1/4) in the unit channel for σ. The Hilbert-space presentation uses specified canonical unitors rather than literal equalities of Hilbert spaces.

The physical model has finite periodic length L≥2, binary heights, Hamiltonian H_L=−JΣ_j(Z_jZ_{j+1}+X_j), J>0 in energy units, and ℏ=1. Euclidean propagation is e^(−sH_L), with s≥0 in inverse-energy units.

The endodefect is D_L=R_LK_L with reflection identification r_j=ĥ_(1/2−j), using periodic indices. The square D_L²=I+P_L uses this reflection convention; repeated fixed half-site identification is explicitly excluded because it retains a translation.

Finite-model topologicality concerns only declared whole-slice slides through gaps containing no other tensor insertion, with all boundary data fixed. Junction recoupling is a separate componentwise identity. Network contractions are unnormalized, include each site weight once, and assign weights 1 to ordinary sites and √2 to empty sites. No continuum limit or empirical conclusion is asserted.

load_bearing.statement: Defines the complex-linear finite-direct-sum category candidate on 1, ψ and σ, its Ising fusion rules, specified associators, strict skeletal unitors and self-duality maps. It specifies data; the separate coherence result checks the fusion-category axioms.

The explicitly specified category of triples of finite-dimensional complex Hilbert spaces, with the displayed tensor product, associators, canonical unitors, duality maps, dagger and weighted Hom inner products, satisfies all the conditions of a unitary fusion category in the Statement's explicit sense.

For the selected finite periodic model with L≥2 and the stated decorated-network prescription, D_L is topological under the declared defect slides, D_L²=I+P_L, P_L²=I, D_LP_L=P_LD_L=D_L, and the junction spaces and associators are the specified finite semisimple unitary Ising fusion data. D_L is non-invertible. No continuum limit or empirical fact is asserted.

seams_checked.note: The theorem uses the draft topological-defect supplier for formulation and explicitly declares its finite-lattice slide notion, complete correlators and fixed boundary data. It does not claim arbitrary smooth continuum isotopy invariance. The kernel intertwiner diagram is correctly typed. Independent integer-arithmetic checks at L=2,3,4,5 confirmed symmetry, the square, Hamiltonian commutation and spin-flip identities.

The draft fusion-data supplier distinguishes multiplicities from associators, duality and physical realization, and does not infer unitarity. The owned lemma supplies these additional checks explicitly. Its exact pentagon checker passed all 19,683 assignments, including 132 nonzero assignments. The local F-symbol conventions also agree with the consulted Aasen–Mong–Fendley equations (4.19)–(4.21): [primary source](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1601.07185).

The abstract example uses the supplier's two-sided tensor-inverse definition and proves the stronger absence of a right inverse by comparing simple multiplicities, including arbitrary nonnegative multiplicities and the zero object. It makes no physical-realization inference.
